research_question: Under the frozen continuous protocol that produced the REM-Net seed-42 benchmark, how do five published radar-to-ECG families perform on the same 11 loso_v2 folds?

mmecg_tcn.paper: Chen et al., Contactless ECG Monitoring With Millimeter Wave Radar, IEEE TMC 2024
adaptations: D1 input: the paper's 50 K-means voxel signals at length 640 are replaced by this dataset's 50 range-bin RCG at length 1600 (the same tensor every other baseline sees).

D2 decoding: the paper's autoregressive 256-way mu-law softmax over previous ECG samples is replaced by a parallel continuous head. Autoregressive decoding of 1600 steps per window is computationally prohibitive at 11-fold scale, and the frozen contract scores continuous raw-ECG regression, not mu-law classes. The causal dilated TCN stack, the CNN-Transformer spatio-temporal encoder and the receptive field are kept.
D3 position embedding: the paper embeds each voxel's 3D coordinates; range-bin index embeddings are used instead because the processed dataset exposes bins, not voxels.

radarode_mtl.paper: Zhang et al., radarODE-MTL, IEEE TIM 2025
adaptations: D1 input: WSST (50, 71, 240) covering the full 8 s window instead of the 4 s (50, 71, 120) tensor, matching the support REM-Net receives.

D2 output: the published ECG_shape (200) / PPI (260) / anchor (800) heads cannot produce a continuous 1600-sample stream without the long-term assembly this project could not faithfully reproduce (claim ledger F2). The official DCNResNet + squeeze backbone is kept verbatim from the authors' repository and an adapted continuous decoder built from the authors' own DeconvBlock/ConvBlock stack emits 1x1600.
D3 multitask: EGA gradient alignment across ECG_shape/PPI/anchor is not exercised, because only the continuous task is scored. Label the row 'adapted (continuous head)'.

wavegru_net.paper: Xu et al., WaveGRU-Net, Signal Processing 2025
adaptations: D1 input: MIMO beamforming to one phase channel is replaced by this dataset's 50 range-bin RCG; MODWT is applied per bin.

D2 transform: MODWT is realised as a fixed a-trous (undecimated) sym4 filter bank with 5 levels (6 bands) running inside the model on GPU, checked against pywt.swt. The paper's basis, level count and shift invariance are preserved.
D3 length: the paper's 1x1024 slices become the contract's 1x1600 windows.

D4 width: 50 bins x 6 bands would make the published 64-tap convolutions disproportionately wide, so a 1x1 band-mixing layer reduces 300 channels to 32 before the published 3-block CNN. The CNN, transposed-convolution module, Bi-GRU and dropout head keep the published structure.

attention_dcgan.paper: Jin et al., Attention-DCGAN, IEEE Sensors Journal 2025
adaptations: D1 segmentation: the paper feeds 200-sample fragments centred on ECG R peaks. Under the strict continuous contract that segmentation is a ground-truth oracle, so the generator maps the whole 8 s window instead.

D2 output activation: the paper's Tanh output is kept and followed by a fixed gain fitted on the TRAINING fold only, because the contract's target lives in train-fold robust-scaled units rather than the paper's [-1, 1] range.
D3 optimiser: the paper's Adam lr 3e-4 / batch 32 is replaced by the protocol budget (AdamW lr 1e-4, batch 16, 100 epochs, patience 15), identical to every other arm.

cross_modal_conformer.paper: Liu et al., Cross-Modal Autoencoder, IEEE Sensors Journal 2024
adaptations: D1 input: the paper's 1x1000 single-channel mmWave slice becomes the 50-bin RCG at length 1600.

D2 pretraining: the ECG-to-ECG autoencoder and the cardiac-event predictor are pretrained per fold on TRAINING-fold ECG only (never validation or test), preserving the paper's deep-feature loss. Set --pretrain_epochs 0 to disable, which drops the deep-feature term and must then be reported as a removed component.
D3 loss: waveform MSE + STFT-magnitude MSE, as published.

protocol.validation: one distinct subject per fold; checkpoint selection only
protocol.test: one held-out subject per fold; opened exactly once after checkpoint selection
protocol.split_invariants: identical fold files, hashes and subject assignment as the REM-Net run
protocol.input: WSST (50,71,240) full-window for radarode_mtl; native-rate rcg (50,1600) for the other four, exactly as each paper's modality requires
protocol.target: blind continuous 1x1600 ECG in train-fold robust-scaled space; reported in raw ECG units
protocol.test_oracles_prohibited: No test-derived scaler, lag, affine map, range-bin selection, threshold, checkpoint, or model choice. R-peak-centred segmentation is prohibited for every baseline.

training.budget: 100 epochs maximum, patience 15, AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 16
training.objective: each baseline's own published objective (MSE; waveform+spectrogram MSE with deep-feature loss for cross_modal_conformer; adversarial + L1 for attention_dcgan)
training.checkpoint: maximum frozen validation composite, the same 0.40 PCC + 0.25 (1-min(NRMSE,1)) + 0.20 max(R2,0) + 0.15 F1@100 rule as REM-Net; Shape-200 excluded
training.composite_disclosure: The NRMSE term is identically zero in the observed operating range and max(R2,0) is zero on negative-R2 epochs, so selection is effectively PCC + waveform F1@100 for every arm alike.

metrics.evaluator: scripts/train_continuous_ecg_pilot.evaluate, imported rather than copied, so baseline and REM-Net numbers come from one implementation
metrics.event_head: absent in all five baselines; event_f1_* is NOT APPLICABLE and must be left blank in tables, never reported as zero
metrics.aggregation: fold-macro mean and population standard deviation over 11 test subjects; per-fold values retained
binding_reporting_rules: RR/HR aggregate only over folds with rr_coverage >= 0.80; excluded folds are listed as failure cases (METRIC_CONTRACT R1).
above_10hz_energy_ratio is reported as median with IQR plus per-fold values (METRIC_CONTRACT R2).
RMSE/MAE/region MAE are in per-record z-score units; every table states units, aggregation style and the population-std convention (METRIC_CONTRACT R3).
metrics.nan_policy: nanmean within evaluator; record NaN/failed values before promotion

artifacts: per-fold config with its adaptation list
promotion_limit: One seed of the registered three-seed audit; conclusions use all three seeds.

multi_seed_audit.changes: seed base only; model, loss, budget, split, scaler, evaluator and checkpoint rule are identical
